chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about the prayer in the Masjid of Ghadir Khumm during the day, while I was a traveler, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Pray in it, for there is merit in it, and my father used to order with that.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying in Masjid Ghadir Khumm while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the spiritual merit (fadl) of Masjid Ghadir Khumm, specifically highlighting the permissibility and virtue of praying there during the day while traveling. It underscores the continuity of this practice through the Imams, as Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) confirms that his father, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him), also commanded it, reinforcing the site's significance in Shia devotional geography.
